observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same sewing machine on a wooden table with metal legs, placed on a tiled floor against a textured wall.
The sewing machine is black with gold/yellow decorative patterns and a large handwheel on the right side.
The machine has a foot pedal attached to the stand, suggesting manual operation.
A measuring tape is draped over the machine.
The brand name 'SINGER' is visible in gold lettering on the front of the machine in both photos.
A green label with white text is visible on the machine, but the text is too small to read clearly.
The stand is a foldable wooden table with metal legs and a foot pedal platform.
No power cord or motor is visible, consistent with a manual machine.
The machine appears to be in used condition with some visible wear and minor debris on the table.

risks.proof: A close-up shot of the stand's joints, legs, and foot pedal mechanism from multiple angles.

risks.risk: The machine may have hidden damage or missing parts (e.g., bobbin case, presser foot, or accessories).
risks.proof: A close-up shot of the bobbin area, presser foot, and any included accessories laid out.

Close-up shots of the stand's joints, legs, and foot pedal mechanism.
Close-up of the bobbin area, presser foot, and any included accessories.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a SINGER sewing machine with stand, and the seller's claims are supported by the photos. The machine appears to be manual, as stated. Hidden risks exist regarding functionality and condition, but these are priced at their worst case (e.g., not working, unstable stand) until proven otherwise.
